name: Morita Sakuya
source: A girl who has always wished to be born as a boy. When she was young, she failed from saving a little boy from his kidnapper. This incident made her wish to be a strong man whom everyone can rely on. She hates to dress like a girl, because she thinks it made her look like a wimp. She transforms into a boy inside the virtual theme park.
